name: @jrbemt/mcpbundler
stderr:
Usage: mcpbundler [options] [command]

MCP Bundler - Aggregate multiple MCP servers into one

Options:
  -V, --version        output the version number
  -h, --host [host]    server adress of the mcpbundler API (default:
                       "http://0.0.0.0:3997")
  -t, --token [token]  user token for API authentication (mcpb_*)
  --help               display help for command

Commands:
  mcp                  manage MCPs
  bundle               manage bundles
  user                 manage API users (requires --token)
  stdio [options]      connect to bundler and expose as an STDIO Server for
                       local integrations
  help [command]       display help for command

For more information and updates checkout: https://github.com/JRbemt/mcpbundler
